name: 32nd Bit Avoidance Modification
definition: Modifications to the solid voxelization algorithm to avoid using the 32nd bit, which is reserved for different purposes. This involves modifying the 1D texture to exclude the highest bit.
summary: The 32nd Bit Avoidance Modification excludes the highest bit of 32-bit storage to prevent conflicts with reserved purposes, distinguishing it from general sparse voxelization by targeting bit-packing constraints in dense grids.
